title: Finite evaluation of normalized strict-system restriction comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a map $a:B_\bullet\to C_\bullet$ of the finite $\ell$-power-torsion coefficient sequences of [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data], schemes $X,Z,Y$, an open immersion $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, any morphism $p:Z\to Y$, and ANY normalized Comparison datum $d$ of [def-sp-system-compact-support-restriction-data]. Use the actual geometric operations and evaluation comparisons of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Then FiniteCompatibility d of [def-sp-system-compact-support-restriction-evaluation] is inhabited. Explicitly: the constant coefficient maps commute with the canonical geometric ring isomorphisms at every level; there are finite open comparisons normalized by the original derived open-adjunction units; evaluation of d.openPart is those comparisons after conjugation by restrictionEvaluation and evalJ; evaluation of d.properPart.iso is levelProper after conjugation by restrictionEvaluation and evalP. These are equalities of the specified comparison words, never an inference from faithfulness of evaluation.

proof.text: Naturality of the canonical constant-sheaf inverse-image map gives LevelComm for j and p. The four remaining fields are supplied by the strictly smaller finite open-isomorphism, open-unit-normalization, open-evaluation and proper-evaluation statements, and the structure is assembled directly.
